Homunculus disrupts party plans more than expected - telepathic bond with its master creates strategic depth.

DMs: Use the Homunculus's 40-foot fly speed to maintain its telepathic bond while staying out of melee range.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Desert Rider progression trap delays effectiveness - flashy picks postpone your core engine by multiple.

GMs: Keep players focused on using Charge and mount AC boosts; discourage flashy distractions that undermine their core strengths.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Spirit Guardians shifts the battlefield in unexpected ways - its 15-foot radius punishes clustered foes.

DMs: Cast Spirit Guardians when you can protect concentration, punishing clustered foes with 3d8 damage in a 15-foot radius.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Give Crimson Stain Primeval Slime a real price.

Judges: When they turtle up, unleash the slime's smother attack to remind them that movement matters more than damage.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Curse alters the game state more than players expect - its effect is permanent.

GMs: Use Curse's permanent effect to turn an enemy's ally against them, forcing a strategic shift in their plans.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Stone Giant's Boulder attack surprises with its reach - 60-foot range allows for unexpected engagement.

DMs: Remind players that the Stone Giant's Boulder attack has a 60-foot range, encouraging them to spread out and avoid clustering.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Death Dealer (Bane Weapon) delivers instant death to its bane - Fort save DC is 1d20+10.

Judges: Confirm the enemy type matches the Death Dealer's bane to exploit that 1d20+10 Fort save, or it's just a fancy knife.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Torch and Light often gets mismanaged - torches burn for 1 hour of real time.

GMs: Set a timer for each torch's 1-hour real-time burn to avoid players stumbling around in the dark.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

College of Glamour's Mantle of Inspiration surprises with its efficiency - a bonus action grants temporary HP.

DMs: Use Mantle of Inspiration's bonus action for consistent temporary HP; it's your reliable tool, not a flashy distraction.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Experience Points are earned in small amounts - 0 to 4 points per encounter based on danger.

Judges: Award 0-4 XP per encounter based on danger; stop rewarding players for grinding through trivial fights.

Winter Wolf earns its stakes fast.

GMs: Remind them that clustering invites disaster; the Winter Wolf's Frost Breath recharges in 1d4 rounds, not the usual longer wait.
